paper_title: Constrained and Ordered Level Planarity Parameterized by the Number of Levels
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
Theory of computation → Fixed parameter tractability
statement: 1. We have shown that 3-level CLP can be solved in polynomial time, without optimizing the runtime of our algorithm. Can 3-level CLP be solved in, say, quadratic time? 2. In the problem variant Connected CLP, we insist that the given constrained level graph is connected. It is easy to make the graph in our NP-hardness proof for 4-level CLP connected by adding two new levels, so 6-level Connected CLP is NP-hard. What is the complexity of 5-level Connected CLP?
